text:
**Score:** 5.5/10

**Bottom line:** I would not approve this as-is. The code is readable and reasonably organized, but the project is not cleanly runnable from source, has stale/generated artifacts in-tree, and has several robustness gaps around model loading, dataset bootstrap, and memory use.

I could not run the test suite successfully in this container: `pytest -q` fails at collection because dependencies such as `numpy` and `PyYAML` are not installed. Static AST parsing of `emovec/*.py` succeeded.

| Severity | File | Lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| high | `emovec/cli.py` | 54-58 | `generate-stories` requires `data/stories/manifest.json` before stories can be generated, so a clean checkout cannot bootstrap the dataset. |
| high | `config.yaml` | 11-13 | Default config points at `data/stories`, but the tree only contains an empty `data/stories` directory. |
| high | `emovec/model.py` | 167-180 | `all_token_activations` stacks every hidden state for each batch on CPU, which can spike memory into GBs for the configured model/batch/token sizes. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py` | 52-65 | Passing only `hf_model` or only `tokenizer` silently triggers a full model/tokenizer reload and discards the provided object. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py` | 73-75 | Model internals are hard-coded to `hf.model.layers`, so changing `model.name` can break despite being configurable. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py` | 302-304 | Logit lens assumes `hf.model.norm` and `lm_head.weight` semantics specific to Gemma-like causal LMs. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py` | 230-237 | Steering hooks depend on mutable shared `self._steer_mask`, making inference non-reentrant and unsafe for concurrent calls. |
| medium | `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` | 167-174 | Integration test downloads/loads gated `google/gemma-2-2b` without skip logic for missing Hugging Face auth, so clean CI will fail. |
| medium | `pyproject.toml` | 10-19 | Runtime and dev dependencies are only lower-bounded, leaving reproducibility exposed to breaking upstream releases. |
| low | `emovec/stories.py` | 78-83 | Story loading does not validate the manifest or aggregate missing file errors; failures surface as raw `read_text` exceptions mid-run. |
| low | `emovec/vectors.py` | 37-40 | `emotion_vectors` returns NaNs if any emotion label has zero examples instead of failing fast. |
| low | `emovec/vectors.py` | 66-70 | PCA divides by `var.sum()` without handling zero-variance input. |
| low | `emovec.egg-info/SOURCES.txt` | 17-22 | Generated packaging metadata is present in the codebase despite `.gitignore` excluding `*.egg-info/`. |
| low | `outputs/tiny/vectors/manifest.json` | 1-98 | Generated run artifacts are present under `outputs/`, creating stale source-of-truth risk. |

**Estimated rewrite/significant-change size:** about 260 lines. Most of that is dataset bootstrap/config cleanup, streaming or chunked activation handling, model-wrapper guards, dependency/CI hardening, and focused tests for the failure modes above.

issues.description: generate-stories requires data/stories/manifest.json before stories can be generated, so a clean checkout cannot bootstrap the dataset.
Default config points at data/stories, but the tree only contains an empty data/stories directory.
all_token_activations stacks every hidden state for each batch on CPU, risking GB-scale memory spikes.
Partial dependency injection of hf_model or tokenizer silently reloads and discards the provided object.
Model internals are hard-coded to hf.model.layers despite model.name being configurable.
Logit lens assumes Gemma-like norm and lm_head internals.
Steering hooks rely on mutable shared self._steer_mask, making concurrent inference unsafe.
Integration test loads a gated Hugging Face model without skip logic for missing auth or model access.
Dependencies are only lower-bounded, weakening reproducibility against upstream breaking releases.
Story loader does not validate manifest consistency or aggregate missing file errors before running.
emotion_vectors produces NaNs when an emotion has zero examples instead of failing fast.
PCA variance ratio divides by zero for zero-variance input.
Generated packaging metadata is present in the codebase despite ignore rules.
Generated model artifacts are present under outputs, risking stale results being mistaken for source truth.
